title: In Focus | The AI promise was automation. The reality? Managing digital workers
script:
AI was promised to automate your entire job.
The reality is that workers are now becoming managers of digital agents.
South China Morning Post notes this shift creates a new administrative burden.
Employees must now constantly prompt, verify, and correct AI outputs.
This oversight loop keeps humans stuck in the loop of digital supervision.
Companies now dedicate significant time to managing these internal digital workflows.
Would you rather do the tasks yourself or supervise an AI?
